findings.description: delete_entry calls _require_reader, so any user the entry is shared with can permanently delete the owner's journal entry. Every other destructive or mutating handler (edit, share, unshare) uses _require_owner. A reader who was only meant to view the entry can destroy it, which is data loss.
findings.title: delete_entry authorizes with _require_reader instead of _require_owner
